info.name: SpreeWe Developer API
info.description:
Complete SpreeWe third-party developer API, generated from the backend route registry (`webrtc-BE/src/api/v1`), the OAuth router and the session routes that accept developer-app tokens.

**Auth types used**
* `{{access_token}}`: developer-app user token (OAuth or server exchange). Renewed automatically by the collection pre-request script.
* `{{clerk_session_token}}`: the test user's own SpreeWe session, for first-party endpoints (Developer Portal, consent decisions, teams, org admin). Short-lived: paste a fresh one when told.
* HTTP Basic `{{client_key_id}}:{{client_secret}}`: the app's server credential.

Requests check their prerequisites and are **skipped** (with a console message) instead of sending incomplete data. Destructive requests need `{{allow_destructive}} = true`.

Not covered by REST (Socket.IO only): sending/editing/reacting to messages, typing/read receipts, call signaling and media, group admin events. See **Realtime prerequisites**.

See README.md next to this file for import, configuration and run order.

exec: // SpreeWe collection pre-request: credential presence checks and automatic app-token renewal.
// Runs before every request. It never invents tokens: it only reuses the refresh token / app
// credential you obtained in the Auth folders.
const __v = (k) => { const x = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{' + k + '}}'); return x === '{{' + k + '}}' ? '' : x; };

const __set = (k, val) => { if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return; val = String(val); if (pm.environment.name) { pm.environment.set(k, val); } else { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, val); } console.log('saved {{' + k + '}}'); };

const __skip = (why) => { console.warn('[skipped] ' + pm.info.requestName + ': ' + why); if (pm.execution && typeof pm.execution.skipRequest === 'function') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); } else { throw new Error('Skipped: ' + why); } };

const __jwt = (t) => { try { let p = String(t).split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'); while (p.length % 4) p += '='; return JSON.parse(CryptoJS.enc.Base64.parse(p).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8)); } catch (e) { return null; } };
let __auth = null;
try {
const a = pm.request.auth;
if (a && a.type === 'bearer') {
let t = typeof a.parameters === 'function' ? a.parameters().get('token') : null;
const m = /\{\{(\w+)\}\}/.exec(String(t || ''));
__auth = m ? m[1] : 'bearer';

} else if (a && a.type === 'basic') { const u = typeof a.parameters === 'function' ? String(a.parameters().get('username') || '') : ''; __auth = u.includes('{{client_key_id}}') ? 'basic' : 'basic-literal'; }
} catch (e) { __auth = null; }
pm.variables.set('__auth_var', __auth || '');
const __now = Date.now();
if (__auth === 'clerk_session_token') {
const t = __v('clerk_session_token');
if (!t) { __skip('set {{clerk_session_token}} (a SpreeWe/Clerk session token of your test user, see README)'); }

else { const c = __jwt(t); if (c && c.exp && c.exp * 1000 < __now) __skip('{{clerk_session_token}} expired at ' + new Date(c.exp * 1000).toISOString() + ' - copy a fresh one (Clerk session tokens are short-lived)'); }
} else if (__auth === 'basic') {
if (!__v('client_key_id') || !__v('client_secret')) __skip('set {{client_key_id}} and {{client_secret}} (Developer Portal folder: Create a server credential)');
} else if (__auth === 'access_token') {
const exp = Number(__v('access_token_expires_at') || 0);
const missing = !__v('access_token');
if (missing || (exp && __now > exp - 30000)) {
const source = __v('token_source');
const base = __v('base_url');
if (source === 'oauth' && __v('refresh_token') && __v('auto_refresh') !== 'false') {
console.log('access token expired/missing: refreshing with the OAuth refresh token');
pm.sendRequest({
url: base + '/oauth/token', method: 'POST',
header: [{ key: 'Content-Type', value: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }],
body: { mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [
{ key: 'grant_type', value: 'refresh_token' },
{ key: 'client_id', value: __v('oauth_client_id') },
{ key: 'refresh_token', value: __v('refresh_token') } ] },
}, (err, res) => {
let b = null; try { b = res.json(); } catch (e) {}
if (err || !res || res.code !== 200 || !b || !b.access_token) { console.warn('OAuth refresh failed: ' + (err || (res && res.code) + ' ' + JSON.stringify(b))); return; }
__set('access_token', b.access_token); __set('refresh_token', b.refresh_token);
__set('access_token_expires_at', Date.now() + b.expires_in * 1000); __set('token_scopes', b.scope);
} else if (source === 'server' && __v('client_key_id') && __v('client_secret') && (__v('me_user_id') || __v('external_user_ref')) && __v('auto_refresh') !== 'false') {
console.log('access token expired/missing: minting a new one with the app server credential');
const basic = 'Basic ' + CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(__v('client_key_id') + ':' + __v('client_secret')));
const who = __v('token_subject') === 'external' && __v('external_user_ref') ? { externalUserRef: __v('external_user_ref') } : { userId: __v('me_user_id') };
pm.sendRequest({
url: base + '/v1/app-tokens', method: 'POST',
header: [{ key: 'Content-Type', value: 'application/json' }, { key: 'Authorization', value: basic }],
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(who) },
}, (err, res) => {
let b = null; try { b = res.json(); } catch (e) {}
if (err || !res || res.code !== 201 || !b || !b.data) { console.warn('Token exchange failed: ' + (err || (res && res.code) + ' ' + JSON.stringify(b))); return; }
__set('access_token', b.data.accessToken); __set('access_token_expires_at', Date.parse(b.data.expiresAt)); __set('token_scopes', (b.data.scopes || []).join(' '));
} else if (missing) {
__skip('no {{access_token}} yet - run "Auth: OAuth 2.0 + PKCE" or "Auth: Server-to-server token exchange" first');
// SpreeWe collection tests: run after every request.
if (pm.variables.get('__allow_5xx') !== '1') pm.test('No 5xx server error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

if (pm.response.code === 401) console.warn('401: token missing, expired, revoked, or the app/grant/membership is no longer valid. App tokens: re-run the auth folder. Clerk: paste a fresh session token.');
if (pm.response.code === 403) { let b = null; try { b = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {} console.warn('403: ' + JSON.stringify(b && (b.error || b.message || b.error_description) || '')); }

if (pm.response.code === 429) console.warn('429 rate limited. RateLimit headers: ' + (pm.response.headers.get('RateLimit') || pm.response.headers.get('RateLimit-Policy') || 'n/a') + '. Add a delay between requests in the Runner.');

item.name: E2E Workflows
item.description:
Ordered, runnable end-to-end flows built from the same requests as the reference folders. Run each folder with the Collection Runner in order (W1 → W9).

Requests whose prerequisites are missing (no consent yet, no peer user, no E2EE client output, destructive flag off) are **skipped with a console message**, never faked.

item.name: W1 App registration & server-to-server auth
item.description: Clerk session → register app → credential → consent request → user approves → token exchange → call the API with the app token.

request.description:
**Register an app (global from the personal context, or bound to the active workspace).**

Global app (`app_tenant_bound` = false): the Clerk session must be in the **personal** context (no active organization). Workspace app (`true`): the session must have the organization active and you must be its owner/admin. Development apps may use `http://localhost` redirect URLs; production apps need https. Quotas shown are the development caps.

tenantBound apps need the workspace owner/admin role and act only in that workspace. Scopes default to none.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v1/apps`
**Auth:** SpreeWe first-party session only (`Bearer {{clerk_session_token}}`). Developer-app tokens are refused with 403.
**Rate limit:** stricter per-IP limit for sensitive endpoints (`RATE_LIMIT_SENSITIVE_MAX`, default 60/min).
**Body:** `{ name: string, description?: string, websiteUrl?: string, environment: "development" | "production", tenantBound?: boolean, scopes?: enum(32)[], allowedOrigins?: string[], callbackUrls?: string[], quotas?: { rateLimitPerMinute?: integer, maxConnections?: integer, messagesPerDay?: integer } }` (unknown fields are rejected with 400)
**Response `data`:** `{ _id?: string, name?: string, description?: string, websiteUrl?: string, environment?: "development" | "production", status?: "active" | "suspended" | "revoked", tenantId?: string, scopes?: enum(32)[], allowedOrigins?: string[], callbackUrls?: string[], quotas?: { rateLimitPerMinute?: integer, maxConnections?: integer, messagesPerDay?: integer } }`
**Expected status:** 201

**Saves:** `{{app_id}}`, `{{app_name}}`

_Source: `webrtc-BE/src/api/v1/developer.routes.ts`_

request.description:
**Create a server credential — the secret is shown ONLY in this response (owner; confirmation).**

`confirm` must be the app's exact name. Requires a recent sign-in (within 10 minutes) when the Clerk session carries the `fva` claim. The secret is returned **only** here and saved to `{{client_secret}}` (environment type: secret).

**Endpoint:** `POST /v1/apps/:appId/credentials`
**Auth:** SpreeWe first-party session only (`Bearer {{clerk_session_token}}`). Developer-app tokens are refused with 403.
**Rate limit:** stricter per-IP limit for sensitive endpoints (`RATE_LIMIT_SENSITIVE_MAX`, default 60/min).
**Body:** `{ confirm: string, expiresInDays?: integer }` (unknown fields are rejected with 400)
**Response `data`:** `{ credential?: { _id?: string, keyId?: string, hint?: string, status?: "active" | "rotated" | "revoked", graceUntil?: string, expiresAt?: string, lastUsedAt?: string }, secret?: string }`
**Expected status:** 201

**Saves:** `{{credential_id}}`, `{{client_key_id}}`, `{{client_secret}}`

_Source: `webrtc-BE/src/api/v1/developer.routes.ts`_

Same endpoint as Account → Me, called with the user's own session to learn the SpreeWe user id needed for server-side token exchange.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v1/me`
**Auth:** SpreeWe first-party session only (`Bearer {{clerk_session_token}}`). Developer-app tokens are refused with 403.
**Scope (app tokens):** `profile:read`
**Response `data`:** `{ user?: { _id?: string, username?: string, email?: string, avatar?: string, globalDiscoverable?: boolean }, context?: { tenantId?: string, role?: "owner" | "admin" | "member" } }`
**Expected status:** 200

**Saves:** `{{me_user_id}}`

_Source: `webrtc-BE/src/api/v1/routes.ts`_

request.description:
**The signed-in user and active context.**

Postman collections can't drive Socket.IO, so messaging, call signaling and group member events are tested with a Socket.IO client. This request verifies the prerequisites:

* connect to the **server origin** (`{{socket_url}}`, path `/socket.io`) with `auth: { token: <access_token> }` (fresh token on every reconnect);
* the token needs `realtime:connect`; each event needs its scope (see the console log of this request);
* browser origins must be in the app's `allowedOrigins`;
* `sendMessage` text/media must carry a Megolm `e2ee` payload `{ algorithm: 'm.megolm.v1.aes-sha2', ciphertext, session_id, sender_key, device_id }`; plaintext is rejected with `message:rejected` (reason `unencrypted`).

request.description:
**The signed-in user and active context.**

Postman collections can't drive Socket.IO, so messaging, call signaling and group member events are tested with a Socket.IO client. This request verifies the prerequisites:

* connect to the **server origin** (`{{socket_url}}`, path `/socket.io`) with `auth: { token: <access_token> }` (fresh token on every reconnect);
* the token needs `realtime:connect`; each event needs its scope (see the console log of this request);
* browser origins must be in the app's `allowedOrigins`;
* `sendMessage` text/media must carry a Megolm `e2ee` payload `{ algorithm: 'm.megolm.v1.aes-sha2', ciphertext, session_id, sender_key, device_id }`; plaintext is rejected with `message:rejected` (reason `unencrypted`).
